blocks.x: Forecast error down 31% — imbalance cost recovered across three control zones

A European TSO-DSO group: a Energy & Utilities program run on the outcome-linked model with a blended Achala IT Solutions team. The name stays behind the NDA; the numbers are published with permission.
Renewable/demand forecasts legacy; imbalance and curtailment climbing.
Substation assets uninstrumented; failures unscheduled. CIP/62443 evidence assembled manually; flat zones persisted.

The forecasting platform couples weather to asset-level generation and demand with uncertainty bands feeding the scheduling hub; substation telemetry (transformer/breaker condition) now predicts failures; and the OT security program delivered 62443 zoning with continuous evidence — security preceded every instrumentation wave.

blocks.x: The three things that made it hold

items: the data spine was certified once and reused everywhere, which is why the numbers held up under audit.
the agents ran inside a policy envelope with replay, so autonomy never outran the evidence.
the controls were architectural — identity-first, segmented, instrumented — not bolted on after the fact.

blocks.x: If you are considering the same pattern

What transferred directly from the European TSO-DSO group program: the decision pattern and the evidence design. What never transfers: the estate's quirks — which is why every program re-runs the baseline diagnostic on its own data before any build The engagement model here was outcome-linked; the same pattern runs fixed-scope where the estate allows it.
Figures on this page are the client's, reproduced with permission. Method notes and measurement designs are available under NDA.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: the same diagnostic baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
